benchmark: Regime III Quantum-Native Sequence Modeling (Track 1 Born Machine + Track 2 True L2 Unitary SSM)

track1_periodic_interference.task: Periodic-4 Quantum Interference P*(x) ∝ cos^2(pi/4 * sum x_t)

track1_dyck1.task: Dyck-1 balanced brackets (strict disjoint T=14 -> OOD T=16)

track2_s3_state_tracking.task: Non-Abelian S_3 word problem (6 classes, random baseline 1/6=0.1667)

track2_deterministic_delayed_recall.task: Clean Deterministic Delayed Recall (all K=4 sequences evaluated exactly; chance=0.2500)

caveat: All runs use exact CPU statevector / tensor-network simulation (no hardware shot noise). MPS Born Machines scale polynomially O(T*V*chi^3) classically and compile to shallow sequential quantum circuits; scaling QuantumUnitarySSM to exponentially large Hilbert spaces requires FTQC.
